A1.definition: a person who advises on legal matters
A1.example: The lawyer advised his client.

A2.definition: To the greatest degree or highest amount.
A2.example: She is the most talented singer here.

B1.definition: A person who supervises a person or an activity at work.
B1.example: Report any equipment fault to your direct supervisor immediately at work.

B2.definition: the state of sticking together; forming a united, integrated, and harmonious community whole
B2.example: Municipal programs were designed to promote social cohesion between long-term residents and new arrivals.

C1.definition: Relating to the measurement or expression of financial and economic data using numbers.
C1.example: Financial analysts conducted a thorough quantitative assessment of market risk metrics prior to approving the institutional portfolio expansion.

C2.definition: The quality of spreading widely throughout an area or group of people; ubiquitous presence.
C2.example: Sociologists documented the pervasiveness of smartphone usage across all demographic sectors, noting its profound impact on daily social interaction.
